_note: 第三種集型的事實庫:**同一個宣稱、跨多個領域**。跟 famous(一篇對一篇)和 lineup(一個效應家族的多次重測)都不同 —— 這裡的數字不是效果量,是『這個因素解釋了多少變異』,分領域列出。2026-08-30 建立,每個數字都附 quote(它出自摘要的哪一句)。
_why_new_kind: 10,000 小時法則在 effect_scan 裡分數 24,311,是 22 個候選裡的第一名,而且是第二名的 2.3 倍。但它的頭條數字是**變異數百分比**,套不進 make_episode.thresholds() 的 d / r 兩軌。硬轉成 r=sqrt(R^2) 雖然數學上精確,螢幕上卻會出現一個觀眾去查論文查不到的數字(論文寫 26%,我印 0.51)。所以寧可多一種集型,不要多一個對不上的數字。
_missing_note: 缺的欄位一律留 null 並在 missing 裡點名,**不推估**。統合分析涵蓋幾篇研究、總共多少人,摘要裡沒有,四個來源(OpenAlex / Semantic Scholar / PubMed / Europe PMC)抓到的摘要都一樣。要用就得我自己讀原文,在那之前旁白不准提。

original.cited_by_approx_note: 文案用的『超過 N 次』。無條件捨去到百位,所以一定是保守的下界。

test.title: Deliberate practice and performance in music, games, sports, education, and professions: a meta-analysis
test.missing_note: 涵蓋研究數與總人數不在摘要裡,四個來源都沒有。**旁白與畫面都不准提**,直到我讀過原文。
test.unit: percent of variance in performance explained by deliberate practice

domains.name: professions
domains.pct_note: 原文是『less than 1%』。存成 1 並標記為上界 —— 畫面與旁白都要唸『less than one percent』,不能唸成 1%。

test.quote: We found that deliberate practice explained 26% of the variance in performance for games, 21% for music, 18% for sports, 4% for education, and less than 1% for professions. [Macnamara, Hambrick & Oswald 2014, abstract]
test.verdict_quote: We conclude that deliberate practice is important, but not as important as has been argued. [same abstract]

episodes.hook: How much you practise is what separates the best from everyone else?
episodes.hook_short: Practice is what separates the best?
episodes.tone_manual_why: 作者自己的結論是『important, but not as important as has been argued』—— 那是『真的有、但比宣稱的小』,不是『不存在』。判 gone 會是**過度宣稱**,而且直接跟我引用的那句話矛盾。這個欄位必須手填:famous_tone 靠信賴區間分檔,這裡沒有信賴區間,讓它自己猜就是拿缺漏當斷言(bystander_effect 那次的錯法)。

episodes.claim: standing in a powerful pose for two minutes makes you more powerful

original.title: Power Posing: Brief Nonverbal Displays Affect Neuroendocrine Levels and Risk Tolerance
original.quote: That a person can, by assuming two simple 1-min poses, embody power and instantly become more powerful has real-world, actionable implications. [Carney, Cuddy & Yap 2010, abstract]
original.n_quote: Carney et al. found that power posing affected levels of hormones such as testosterone and cortisol, financial risk taking, and self-reported feelings of power in a sample of 42 participants [Ranehill et al. 2015, p.653]

test.kind: conceptual replication, experimenter blind to condition
test.title: Assessing the Robustness of Power Posing: No Effect on Hormones and Risk Tolerance in a Large Sample of Men and Women
test.power_quote: Our statistical power to detect an effect of the magnitude reported by Carney et al. was more than 95% [Ranehill et al. 2015, p.653]
test.extra_quote: Neither of the other two behavioral tasks yielded significant differences by condition. [Ranehill et al. 2015, p.654]
test.verdict_quote: Using a much larger sample size but similar procedures as Carney et al. did, we failed to confirm an effect of power posing on testosterone, cortisol, and financial risk taking. We did find that power posing affected self-reported feelings of power; however, this did not yield behavioral effects. [Ranehill et al. 2015, p.654]
test.missing_note: 這一集沒有缺漏欄位 —— 全文讀過,每個數字都附原句。

episodes.hook: Standing in a powerful pose for two minutes makes you more powerful?
episodes.hook_short: Two minutes in a power pose?
episodes.tone_manual_why: 四個結果裡有一個顯著(felt power, p=.017)、三個不顯著。判 gone 是**過度宣稱** —— 有一個真的重現了,而且是原作者也量的那一個。判 held 也不對 —— 那個頻道賣點的三個生理與行為結果全都沒重現。這一集的重點就是**哪一個活下來**,所以定調必須是 shrunk_real 並在片裡講清楚是哪一個。

_unit_note: 兩種單位:`pct`(變異數百分比,10,000 小時那集)與 `d`(Cohen's d,power posing 那集)。**單位不同,畫面就不同** —— d 沒辦法畫成「佔滿格的幾分之幾」,所以走清單而不是長條。硬用同一種畫法就會出現一個觀眾無法解讀的比例尺。
